description: Everything for one game in one call: game lines for every period, every player prop with its move since open and FanDuel's alternate ladder for it, a count by stat and the biggest movers. Use it for a weekly betting report or a research note on one game ("full odds and player props for Chiefs vs Bills"). Find the event_id with list_events or odds_board. A default call costs 8 credits (table: https://fanduelapi.com/credits).

event_id.description: The game's event_id from list_events or odds_board.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Saved so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.
